name: Company OS
tagline: A shared workspace for your team and AI.
description: Keep business plans, customer knowledge, processes, and daily work together. Company OS gives people and AI tools a shared place to work from current company context.

name: Stored
tagline: Shared memory for agents and teams.
description: Keep what your agents learn in one cloud memory your organization can use. Stored makes knowledge available across tools through MCP and API, with context people can inspect and edit.

name: Govern
tagline: Identity and authority for agents that act.
description: Give agents a defined identity, scoped permissions, and an action record. Govern brings policy, approvals, and auditability to the systems where agents work.

name: Cadre
tagline: An on-demand workforce in the cloud.
description: Run AI workers in cloud environments, choose models through OpenRouter, and connect their work to Company OS. Cadre provides a place for agents to carry out the work you direct.

name: Chippi
tagline: From first inquiry to booked tour.
description: Chippi helps real estate teams read inquiries, prioritize leads, prepare follow-ups, and coordinate tours. People stay in control of what gets sent and can review what changed.

name: Scalar
description: Let agents discover leads, enrich records, and manage relationship workflows while your team directs the work. Scalar gives agent activity a structured home in your customer database.

name: TellMe
description: TellMe interviews people and turns their answers into a complete, structured record. It connects the nuance of a conversation with information a team can use.

name: Operate
tagline: A place for agents to finish their work.
description: Give people and agents the project, its history, and its boundaries in one workspace. Operate keeps tasks and decisions visible as work moves from assignment to review.

name: Marketer
tagline: Create, review, and publish your marketing.
description: Turn a product brief into videos, search-focused articles, and advertising drafts. Review the content and publish to connected channels from one workflow.

name: Symbolic
tagline: Direct coding agents from brief to release.
description: Keep requirements, design instructions, project gates, and test evidence together. Symbolic helps teams direct coding agents and review what is ready to move forward.

name: Clusters
tagline: Discover what your agents can do next.
description: A marketplace for skills, agents, prompts, tools, and loops. Discover and install reusable capabilities across agent platforms.
